MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How does the voice move in the fourth tone? (1 mark)
   A. It dips and rises
   B. It stays flat
   C. It rises
   D. It falls sharply

2. Which two words are said with a tone followed by a light syllable? (1 mark)
   A. bàba and gēge
   B. nǐ and hǎo
   C. wǒ and nǐ
   D. dà and xiǎo

3. What does 星期二 (xīngqī'èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. Four
   C. Tuesday
   D. Nine

4. What does 三 (sān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. Seven
   C. Six
   D. Three

5. Fill the blank: 今天是星期____。 (Today is Wednesday.) (1 mark)
   A. 五
   B. 四
   C. 二
   D. 三

6. Which sentence means "Happy birthday to you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 你生日是几月几号?
   B. 我们唱歌。
   C. 祝你生日快乐!
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

7. What does 来 (lái) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cup
   B. Friend
   C. To come
   D. Birthday

8. What does 说 (shuō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wash hands
   B. To listen, to hear
   C. Knee
   D. To speak

9. Fill the blank: 我用耳朵____。 (I use my ears to hear.) (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 说
   C. 听
   D. 看

10. Which sentence means "Where is the sofa?"? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在哪儿?
   B. 冰箱在厨房。
   C. 床在卧室。
   D. 门在左边。

11. What does 旁边 (pángbiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Beside
   C. House
   D. Fridge

12. Which sentence means "The door is on the left."? (1 mark)
   A. 门在左边。
   B. 椅子在桌子下。
   C. 冰箱在厨房。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

13. Which sentence means "This is my older sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 这是我妹妹。

14. Which sentence means "I love you."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妈妈。
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 那是我弟弟。

15. What does 我爱你 wǒ ài nǐ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like you
   B. I am you
   C. I love you
   D. I see you

16. What does 东西放好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put things away well
   B. Wash hands
   C. Sit down
   D. Come here

17. What does 十二月十二号 mean? (1 mark)
   A. 2 October
   B. 12 December
   C. 12 January
   D. 10 December

18. Which word is pronounced chànggē? (1 mark)
   A. 号
   B. 快乐
   C. 祝
   D. 唱歌

19. What does 牛奶 (niúnǎi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Meat
   C. Milk
   D. Spinach

20. Why does repetition help your reading? (1 mark)
   A. It builds smooth, fluent reading
   B. It removes tones
   C. It makes the text shorter
   D. It erases the words

21. What does 风来了 fēng lái le mean? (1 mark)
   A. The snow is white
   B. The rain has come
   C. The wind has come
   D. The sun is big

22. What does 桌子 (zhuōzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Things
   C. Below
   D. House

23. Which Chinese word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. 学校 xuéxiào
   B. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   C. 去 qù
   D. 昨天 zuótiān

24. What does 八 (bā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Ten
   C. Eight
   D. Five

25. Which Chinese word means "seven"? (1 mark)
   A. 六 liù
   B. 四 sì
   C. 十 shí
   D. 七 qī

26. Which sentence means "We cut the cake."? (1 mark)
   A. 你生日是几月几号?
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 我们唱歌。

27. What does 杯子 (bēizi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. Cup
   C. To give (a gift)
   D. To wish

28. Why use recycled materials for a card? (1 mark)
   A. It is not allowed
   B. It is heavier
   C. It reduces waste
   D. It costs more

29. How does too much rain harm the environment? (1 mark)
   A. It can cause floods
   B. It makes the soil drier
   C. It always makes the wind stronger
   D. It makes the sun brighter

30. Which Chinese word means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. 窗户 chuānghu
   B. 厨房 chúfáng
   C. 电视 diànshì
   D. 桌子 zhuōzi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun." (2 marks)

32. Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我. (3 marks)

33. What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example. (2 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 下面. (2 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you." (2 marks)

36. Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English. (3 marks)

37. Explain one way each of these family members might help you: 妈妈 and 哥哥. Then say one way you help them. (4 marks)

38. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)" (2 marks)

39. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好. (2 marks)

40. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间. (2 marks)

41. Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example. (3 marks)

42. Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin. (4 marks)

43. Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson. (5 marks)

44. Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud. (3 marks)

45. Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names. (2 marks)

46. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. (2 marks)

47. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二. (2 marks)

48. How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example. (2 marks)

49. Write three actions of the body and the part that does each. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — It falls sharply
   The fourth tone falls quickly from high to low.

2. A — bàba and gēge
   The second syllable of bàba and gēge is neutral.

3. C — Tuesday
   星期二 (xīngqī'èr) means Tuesday.

4. D — Three
   三 (sān) means three.

5. D — 三
   三 is three, so Wednesday.

6. C — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐! (zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!) means "Happy birthday to you!".

7. C — To come
   来 (lái) means to come.

8. D — To speak
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

9. C — 听
   听 is to hear.

10. A — 沙发在哪儿?
   沙发在哪儿? (shāfā zài nǎr?) means "Where is the sofa?".

11. B — Beside
   旁边 (pángbiān) means beside.

12. A — 门在左边。
   门在左边。 (mén zài zuǒbian.) means "The door is on the left.".

13. C — 这是我姐姐。
   姐姐 is older sister.

14. B — 我爱你。
   我爱你。 (wǒ ài nǐ.) means "I love you.".

15. C — I love you
   爱 is love.

16. A — Put things away well
   东西 is things and 放好 is put away well.

17. B — 12 December
   十二月 is December.

18. D — 唱歌
   唱歌 is pronounced chànggē and means to sing.

19. C — Milk
   牛奶 (niúnǎi) means milk.

20. A — It builds smooth, fluent reading
   Repeated reading builds fluency.

21. C — The wind has come
   风 is wind and 来了 is has come.

22. A — Table
   桌子 (zhuōzi) means table.

23. A — 学校 xuéxiào
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

24. C — Eight
   八 (bā) means eight.

25. D — 七 qī
   七 (qī) means seven.

26. C — 我们切蛋糕。
   我们切蛋糕。 (wǒmen qiē dàngāo.) means "We cut the cake.".

27. B — Cup
   杯子 (bēizi) means cup.

28. C — It reduces waste
   Reusing materials means less rubbish.

29. A — It can cause floods
   Heavy rain causes floods.

30. A — 窗户 chuānghu
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: mum cooks and cares for us; an older brother helps with homework; I help by washing the dishes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each helper, 1 mark for how, 1 mark for your own help. Any sensible answer.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is above the sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.
